# Masteries

Mastery trees from the client: the character mastery tree of each class (`Mastery`; its names and effects are missing from every shipped string table), the fort masteries (`FortMastery`, bought with a fort's tax treasury, used by the whole nation) and the legion masteries (`GuildMastery`, bought with legion gold).

120 pages: 42 complete, 0 partial, 78 stub. Back to the [[wiki/index|game wiki]].
